Chorus 95 Today! Today is a special feast for this parish, given that we are the parish of Christ the King. Our church was opened 95 years ago, that is in 1931. We remember all who worshipped here over those years and received the sacraments. We pray for all who have passed on to the Kingdom of God. A huge thanks is due to all whose generosity ensured the building, maintenance and reconstruction of the church some 25 years ago. And, of course, we acknowledge the response to the heating crisis last year when we stood in need of a new boiler for the church. We thank all the priests who have served here over all those years, especially Fr Kerry Murphy-O’Connor and Fr Billy O’Sullivan, both of whom are doing well. Fr Kerry will be 90 on 31 December. Family of Parishes Newsletter Our Lady Crowned Church St Joseph’s Church & Holy Family Church Sunday 22nd November 2026 Feast of Christ the King ~ Year A Gospel Reflection We Will Be Judged by Love Alone On the final Sunday of our liturgical year, the Gospel speaks to us of endings —and of judgement. We know that, at the end of time, each of us will be judged on how we have lived. Today’s Gospel is a timely reminder to pause and look honestly at our lives. Jesus identifies himself with the poor, the lost, the hungry, the naked, the sick and those in prison: all who need our love. The measure of the final judgement is the love we have shown to these little ones, especially those most in need. So, we must ask ourselves: how will I fare when that moment comes? Will I be found wanting in my actions, my kindness, my compassion and my love? Or will I be judged well because I have loved well, becoming the hands, feet, eyes, ears and arms of Christ, reaching out to those most in need of love? In the end, nothing else will matter: not how much we own, our status in life or our worldly achievements; not the titles we have held or the success of our careers. What matters is love for those who need to be loved. Family of Parishes Clergy Team Moderator & Co-PP: Fr Charles Kiely Our Lady Crowned Church, Upper Mayfield, Cork. Telephone:
